source:
Throw your Dream Hammer at a distant location, inflicting %d%% weapon damage on all targets between you and it.  After reaching its destination, the Dream Hammer will return, potentially hitting targets a second time.
		Learning this talent increases the Accuracy of your Dream Hammer by %d.
target:
将你的梦之巨锤扔向远处，对沿途所有敌方单位造成 %d%% 武器伤害。在到达目标点后，梦之巨锤会飞回，可能再次对沿途目标造成伤害。
		学习此技能会增加梦之巨锤 %d 点命中。

source:
You absorb latent cold around you, turning into an ice elemental - a shivgoroth - for %d turns.
		While transformed, you do not need to breathe, gain access to the Ice Storm talent at level %d, gain %d%% resistance to cuts and stuns, gain %d%% cold resistance, and all cold damage heals you for %d%% of the damage done.
		The power will increase with your Spellpower.

		#AQUAMARINE#Ice storm:#LAST#
		%s
surface_observation: “You absorb latent cold around you”译为“你吸收周围的寒冰围绕你”，语法杂糅且误将 cold 表述为“寒冰”
target:
你吸收周围的寒冰围绕你，将自己转变为纯粹的冰元素——西弗格罗斯，持续 %d 回合。
		转化成元素后，你不需要呼吸并获得等级 %d 的冰雪风暴，获得 %d%% 震慑和流血抵抗，%d%% 寒冷伤害抗性。所有寒冷伤害可对你产生治疗，治疗量基于伤害值的 %d%%。
		效果受法术强度加成。

		#AQUAMARINE#冰雪风暴：#LAST#
		%s

source: Briagh the Great Sand Wyrm. Where do you think Resonating Diamonds come from? They're just regular diamonds until they get stuck between Briagh's scales for a few centuries and get infused with his life rhythms. He sleeps on a hoard of precious gems and metals, you see.
surface_observation: “Where do you think … come from?”误译为“要不然你认为……是哪里来的”，无依据地加入“要不然”并破坏句意
target: 布莱亚，那条巨型沙龙，要不然你认为共鸣钻石是哪里来的？它们原本只是普通的钻石，卡在布莱亚的鳞片间长达几个世纪，逐渐被灌注了生命节律。你看，它正是睡在一堆珍贵宝石和金属上呢。

source:
You focus on a target zone of radius 2 to make up to %d corrosive seeds appear.
		The first seed will appear at the center of the target zone, while others will appear at random spots.
		Each seed lasts %d turns and will explode when a hostile creature walks over it, knocking the creature back and dealing %0.1f Acid damage within radius 1.
		The damage will increase with your Mindpower.
target:
你集中精神于某块半径 2 的区域，制造至多 %d 个腐蚀之种。
		第一个种子会产生于中心处，其他的会随机出现。
		每个种子持续 %d 回合，当一个敌对生物走过腐蚀之种时，会在半径 1 的区域内引发一场爆炸，击退对方并造成 %0.1f 点酸性伤害。
		伤害受精神强度加成。

source: The target is wrapped in disorientating smoke, reducing vision range by %d.
target: 目标被令人迷失方向的烟雾包围，视野减少 %d。

source:
You notice the small things others do not notice, allowing you to "see" creatures in a %d radius even outside of light radius.
		This is not telepathy, however, and it is still limited to line of sight.
		Also, your attention to detail increases stealth detection and invisibility detection by %d, and you gain the ability to detect traps (+%d detect 'power').
		The detection abilities improve with Cunning.
surface_observation: “in a %d radius even outside of light radius”译成“在阴影区域……，%d 码半径范围”，句法残缺，并无依据地加入“码”作为单位
target:
你注意到他人注意不到的细节，甚至能在阴影区域“看到”怪物，%d 码半径范围。
		注意此能力不属于心灵感应，仍然受到视野的限制。
		同时你的细致观察使你侦察潜行和隐身的能力增加 %d，使你发现周围的陷阱的能力增加 %d。
		上述侦测能力均受灵巧加成。

source: The Fortress Shadow said she could be cured.
target: 堡垒之影说她有可能被治愈。

			Combat stats:
			Accuracy: %d
			Damage: %d
			APR: %d
			Crit: %0.2f
			Speed: %0.2f

			战斗属性：
			命中：%d
			伤害：%d
			护甲穿透：%d

			Combat stats:
			Range: %d
			Accuracy: %d
			Damage: %d

			Crit: %0.1f%%
			Speed: %0.1f%%
target:
念动远程武器使用意志和灵巧来分别代替力量和敏捷，以决定命中和伤害。
			战斗属性：
			范围：%d
			命中：%d
			伤害：%d
			护甲穿透：%d
			暴击率：%0.1f%%
			攻击速度：%0.1f%%

source:
I have stared in the mouths of crimson wyrms
And felt the claws of drakes so sleek
But through deserts dry and sandy storms
There is something else I seek

In the trail of giant worms I walk
Through tunnels of sand below
Of arcane tools let there be no talk
It's on the wyrmic path I go!
target:
我曾凝视赤红巨龙的巨口深处
也曾领教矫健幼龙利爪
可穿过干旱荒漠与沙暴
我所追寻的另有其物

我循着巨型沙龙的踪迹
穿行在地下沙土隧道
休要再提那些奥术器具
我走的是龙战士之道！

source:
A bulging rotten robe seems to tear at the seams, with masses of bloated worms spilling out all around the moving form.  Two arm-like appendages, each made up of overlapping mucous-drenched maggots, grasp tightly around the handles of bile-coated waraxes.
Each swing drips pustulant fluid before it, and each droplet writhes and wriggles in the air before splashing against the ground.
target:
一件鼓鼓囊囊的腐烂长袍似乎要从接缝处裂开，成团浮肿的蠕虫从这移动的躯体四周向外涌出。两只臂膀一样的附属物，每只都由沾满黏液的蛆重叠而成，各握着一柄覆有胆汁的战斧。
每一次挥舞都会向前溅出脓液，每一滴脓液在空中扭动翻滚，然后啪嗒一声落在地上。

deep_observation: 术语冲突与机制不符：mod-tome/data/general/objects/egos/wands-powers.lua（commit 624a6732，第 91-95 行）该 keyword 属于 ego " of conjuration"，charm 描述为 "fire a magical bolt dealing %d %s damage"（火/冰/闪电/酸随机），经 class/Object.lua 第 638-646 行以 "entity keyword" 语境拼进物品名，用于提示法杖的攻击型咒法效果；译作「幻化」既不表「咒法/施法攻击」（同版本 ja_JP.lua:10765 作「魔法攻撃」、ko_KR.lua:10885 作「파괴」），又与同一 zh 语料中 Shimmer 系列既有译法冲突（zh_hans.lua:42797/42816/42822/42841/42859 均把 Shimmer 外观系统译为「幻化」），会与外观幻化功能混淆。
surface_observation: 实体关键词“conjure”意为召唤或凭空造出，译为表示变化形态的“幻化”属明显词义错配

source: The robes of this ancient vampire billow with intense winds. Bolts of lightning arc along its body. In its hand it holds a bow, electricity streaking across it.
target: 这只远古吸血鬼的长袍在强风中鼓荡翻涌。闪电在他的周身环绕。他手里握着一把长弓，电弧在这把弓上流转。

surface_observation: “Grave Mistake”中的 Mistake 被译作“光之灾”，原文没有“光”义，标题核心词义明显丢失

source:
Select the fonts look. Fantasy is the default one. Basic is simplified and smaller.
You must restart the game for the change to take effect.
target:
选择字体样式。默认为Fantasy。Basic 为简化的小字体。
重启游戏后生效。

source: @Target@ activates a trap, and its magical energies change.
target: @Target@激活了陷阱，魔法能量变化了。

source: You hide your terrible nature behind a pitiful figure. Those that see you from a distance of %d will ignore you. If you attack or use a talent they will see you for what you are and pity will be deactivated.
target:
你收起可怕的本质伪装成可怜虫。那些在 %d 码外看到你的敌人将忽略你。
		当你攻击或使用技能时，它们会看穿你的本质，怜悯技能将失效。

source: Damage dealt by this weapon is increased by half your critical multiplier, if doing so would kill the target.
target: 这把武器造成的伤害将增加一半的暴击加成，如果这样能秒杀目标。

source:
Well, I need somebody to replace the men you killed. You look sturdy; maybe you could work for me.
You will have to do some dirty work for me, though, and you will be bound to me.  Nevertheless, you may make quite a profit from this venture, if you are as good as you seem to be.
And do not think of crossing me.  That would be... unwise.
target:
好吧，我正需要有人来顶替被你杀掉的那些手下。你看上去挺结实；也许你能替我干活。
不过，你得替我干些脏活，而且你将受制于我。话说回来，只要你的本事真有看上去那么过硬，你也能在这桩买卖中捞到不少好处。
另外，可别动跟我作对的心思。那会……非常不明智。

source: The orb seems to absorb all light.
target: 水晶球似乎吸收了一切光明。

surface_observation: Titanic 在巨型盾牌名称中表示“巨大的／泰坦般的”，译作“泰坦尼克”误成船名音译

source: Deal 200%% of your Dexterity as Light damage (%d).
target: 造成相当于你200%%敏捷值的光系伤害(%d)。

source: Where might I find Briagh's lair??
target: 布莱亚的老巢在什么地方？？

deep_observation: 关系倒置且机制指代错误：mod-tome/data/talents/cursed/fears.lua（commit 624a6732，Tyrant，第 237-256 行）。(1) 原文 "Impose your tyranny on the minds of those who fear you" 指「畏惧你的敌人」，译文「对被你恐惧的目标」把施惧方与受惧方对调，读作「你所畏惧的目标」。(2) 原文延长的是 "their heightened fear and one random existing fear effect"，其中 heightened fear 是独立具名效果 EFF_HEIGHTEN_FEAR（同文件第 74-80 行由 Heighten Fear 天赋在 applyEffect 中单独施加，第 206-235 行为其天赋定义），与新获得的恐惧（EFF_PARANOID/EFF_DISPAIR/EFF_TERRIFIED/EFF_HAUNTED，第 91-100 行随机选取）不是同一效果；译文「增加这一效果和另一个随机的已有恐惧效果」把延长对象说成「刚获得的新恐惧」，漏掉「加剧恐惧」效果，机制描述错误。
source:
Impose your tyranny on the minds of those who fear you. When a foe gains a new fear, you have a %d%% chance to increase the duration of their heightened fear and one random existing fear effect by %d turns, to a maximum of 8 turns.
		Additionally, you gain %d Mindpower and Physical power for 5 turns every time you apply a fear, stacking up to %d times.
surface_observation: their heightened fear 指目标已有的“强化恐惧”，译文却用“这一效果”指代刚获得的新恐惧，改变了延长持续时间的效果对象
target:
提高对被你恐惧的目标的精神专制。当一个敌人获得了一个新的恐惧效果，你有 %d%% 的几率增加这一效果和另一个随机的已有恐惧效果的持续时间 %d 回合，最多 8 回合。
		此外，每当你恐惧一个目标，你获得 %d 精神强度和物理强度，持续 5 回合，最多叠加 %d 层。

For 8 turns you gain the mass and power of a star, drawing all creatures within radius 5 toward you and dealing %0.2f fire, %0.2f light and %0.2f physical damage to all foes and reducing their damage dealt by 30%%.
		Foes closer to you take up to 150%% damage.

你获得 8 回合的星之引力，将周围 5 码范围内的所有生物向你拉扯，并对所有敌人造成 %0.2f 火焰、%0.2f 光系和 %0.2f 物理伤害。他们所造成的伤害减少30%%。

deep_observation: 语义合并致来源错误与术语误用：mod-tome/class/interface/TooltipsData.lua（commit 624a6732，TOOLTIP_INSCRIPTIONS，第 160-164 行）。(1) 原文 "create herbal infusions and runes that can be inscribed on the skin" 是并列的两类刻印（herbal infusions 与 runes），译文「利用提取的植物精华将一些符咒纹刻到皮肤上」把两类合并为一类，并把 runes 也归因于「植物精华」，与游戏中符文属奥术制品的设定相悖（同句后文即区分 "the use of runes of various types is also common among arcane users"）。(2) "A simple regeneration infusion" 译为「一种回复纹身」，把 infusion（注能/药剂类刻印）改称「纹身」，与 inscription/infusion/rune 的既有区分不符。
source:
#GOLD#Inscriptions#LAST#
The people of Eyal have found a way to create herbal infusions and runes that can be inscribed on the skin of a creature.  More exotic types of inscriptions also exist.
Those inscriptions give the bearer always-accessible powers that can be used an unlimited number of times.
A simple regeneration infusion is the most common type of infusion, and the use of runes of various types is also common among arcane users.
surface_observation: 原文并列的草药纹身与符文被合并误译为用植物精华纹刻符咒，且“还存在”被误译为“可能存在”
target:
#GOLD#刻印#LAST#
埃亚尔的人们发明了一种利用提取的植物精华将一些符咒纹刻到皮肤上的技术。此外，可能存在着某些更加奇异的刻印。
刻印给被刻印者提供一些可以无限使用的特殊能力。
通常人们会纹刻一种回复纹身，当然奥术施法者之中还有各种常见的符文。

source:
Folds a single dimension of your weapons (or ammo) upon itself, adding %0.2f temporal damage to your strikes.
		Additionally you have a %d%% chance to gain 10%% of a turn when your weapons hit.
		The damage will scale with your Spellpower.
target:
将武器（或弹药）的一个维度向自身折叠，使你的攻击额外造成 %0.2f 时空伤害。
		同时武器命中时你有 %d%% 几率获得 10%% 回合的时间。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

source: Harness your shadows to their full potential.
target: 最大程度利用你的阴影。

source:
Use a gesture of pain in place of a normal attack to assault the minds of your enemies, inflicting between %0.1f and %0.1f mind damage. If the attack succeeds, there is a %d%% chance to stun your opponent for 3 turns.
		This strike replaces your melee physical and checks your Mindpower against your opponent's Mental Save, and is thus not affected by your Accuracy or the enemy's Defense. The base damage (doubled) and the critical chance of any Mindstars equipped are added in when this attack is performed.
		This talent requires two free or mindstar-equipped hands and has a 25%% chance to inflict brainlock, which can critically hit. The damage will increase with your Mindpower.
		If attacking with two mindstars the attack will trigger their proc effects, if any.
		Mindstars bonuses from damage and physical criticals: (+%d damage, +%d critical chance)
target:
以痛苦手势取代普通攻击，侵袭敌人的心智，造成 %0.1f 至 %0.1f 点精神伤害。若攻击成功，有 %d%% 几率使对手震慑 3 回合。
		这次打击会取代普通近战物理攻击，以你的精神强度对抗对手的精神豁免，因此不受你的命中或敌人闪避影响。发动攻击时，会计入所装备灵晶的双倍基础伤害及暴击几率。
		此技能要求两只手都可用于手势（每只手须为空手或装备灵晶），并有 25%% 几率施加思维封锁；攻击可以暴击。伤害随你的精神强度提高。
		若双手各装备一枚灵晶，攻击还会触发它们的附加效果（若有）。
		灵晶的伤害与物理暴击加成：（+%d 伤害，+%d 暴击几率）
